title: Tree of Life, Tree of Knowledge & Qliphoth — Full Structural Atlas
status: biblical + Jewish Kabbalah + Western esotericism + project synthesis with historical strata separated
purpose: Give the project a durable deep model of the biblical Trees, the ten sefirot, three-pillar Tree diagrams, later 22-path Hermetic layouts, qelippot/qliphoth history, named Western-occult shells and demon correspondences, while preventing later occult diagrams from being backdated into Genesis or medieval Jewish Kabbalah.
master_rule: There is no single timeless 'Tree of Life diagram' or 'Qliphoth tree'. Preserve strata: biblical text -> Jewish mystical developments -> Lurianic repair cosmology -> Christian/Hermetic Qabalah -> modern occult diagrams -> Potatoverse comparison.

texts: Proverbs uses 'tree of life' imagery in other contexts
tree_of_life.core_function: life, access, guarded continuity and later apocalyptic restoration
tree_of_life.project_use: Strong comparator for generativity, Fruit, Seed, healing and guarded return.

tree_of_knowledge_good_evil.core_function: prohibited tree whose fruit marks the knowledge-of-good-and-evil narrative, transgression, altered perception, judgment and expulsion
tree_of_knowledge_good_evil.serpent_relation: Genesis introduces the serpent in the temptation narrative; the text does not name a hierarchy of Qliphothic demons attached to the tree.
tree_of_knowledge_good_evil.project_use: Upstream Knowledge Fork: information/perception can lead toward Life, responsibility and repair or toward distortion, capture and Strife depending on interpretation, motive, action and consequence.
tree_of_knowledge_good_evil.boundary: Do not retrofit the later tenfold Qliphoth or named demons into Genesis as though the biblical text contained them.

daat.name: Da'at / Knowledge
daat.rule: Often appears as an additional/hidden position in later diagrams but is not counted as an eleventh sefirah in the ordinary tenfold count.
daat.project_use: Useful comparator for Knowledge as a relational junction rather than simply another permanent sphere.

three_pillars.right: Common later diagrams group Chokhmah–Chesed–Netzach as an expansive/mercy-side column.
three_pillars.middle: Keter–Tiferet–Yesod–Malkhut provide a mediating/central line in common layouts.
three_pillars.caution: Pillar labels and detailed correspondences differ across Jewish and Hermetic sources; the diagram is a reception history, not one geometrically fixed revealed blueprint.

jewish_kabbalah.thirty_two_paths_context: Sefer Yetzirah famously speaks of thirty-two wondrous paths through ten sefirot and twenty-two Hebrew letters. The later familiar diagram with 22 drawn connecting paths and fixed letter/Tarot attributions belongs especially to Western/Hermetic developments and should be separately typed.

western_hermetic_tree_reference.status: normalized reference layout for project geometry; not asserted as the unique Jewish Tree
western_hermetic_tree_reference.angle_rule: Angles are properties of a chosen drawing, not doctrinal invariants. In the normalized project rendering, each edge angle is computed from its coordinate vector; if coordinates change, the angle changes while the graph relation can remain the same.
western_hermetic_tree_reference.geometry_use: This lets the project study symmetry, centrality, path length, branching and pillar balance without pretending a Euclidean angle proves mystical meaning.

qelippot_historical_layers.description: Qelippah/kelippah means shell or husk; mystical literature develops impurity, the 'Other Side', concealment/capture of vitality and demonic imagery in several forms.
Breaking of the vessels, fallen sparks, shells and tikkun provide a repair/reintegration drama in which trapped vitality is recovered rather than a simple static ten-level 'evil tree'.
Early-modern and nineteenth/twentieth-century occult systems increasingly systematize adverse counterparts, angelic/demonic hierarchies and a diagrammatic counter-tree.
A tenfold Dark Tree with fixed names, rulers, tunnels and path correspondences is a later Western esoteric construction with variations by author/order.

western_occult_tenfold_shell_reference.variant_note: Modern occult diagrams frequently distinguish Nahemoth/Nehemoth as the shell and Lilith/Naamah as rulers or related figures; the assignment is not uniform.

demonology_boundary.rule: There is no single universal ten-demon list valid across Jewish Kabbalah, Lévi, Golden Dawn, Crowley and later occultism.
demonology_boundary.method: Store shell/order name, source-specific ruler/adversary, date/tradition and spelling variant as separate fields.
demonology_boundary.project_translation: When the Potatoverse uses 'demon', prefer a functional relation such as compulsion, fragmentation, capture, distortion or predation unless explicitly describing a tradition's supernatural ontology. Do not label real people as literal demons.

life_strife_knowledge_synthesis.knowledge_tree: signal/data -> provenance -> interpretation -> discernment -> choice -> action -> consequence -> memory/revision
life_strife_knowledge_synthesis.life_branch: knowledge -> verification/context -> responsible action -> repair/nourishment -> independent capacity -> Fruit -> Seed
life_strife_knowledge_synthesis.strife_branch: knowledge -> decontextualized exposure -> provocation/humiliation -> retaliation -> archive -> attention reward -> renewed exposure
life_strife_knowledge_synthesis.qliphothic_condition: A branch becomes shell-like in the project when a boundary captures value/attention, hardens dependency and obstructs meaningful exit or reintegration.
life_strife_knowledge_synthesis.tree_of_life_condition: A branch remains life-giving when differentiation, circulation, correction, Fruit and future Seed increase autonomous capacity.
life_strife_knowledge_synthesis.central_question: What is this knowledge being made to grow?

project_geometry_relations.tree_vs_axis: Axis is the reference line; Tree is the living differentiated organism that can grow around/through it.
project_geometry_relations.tree_vs_mountain: Tree differentiates outward; Mountain converges paths toward a summit.
project_geometry_relations.roots_vs_below: Roots may occupy below/depth without being evil; root position is functional and nutritive before moral classification.
project_geometry_relations.canopy_vs_heaven: Canopy may project into Heaven Plane but is not identical with Heaven or truth.
project_geometry_relations.door_relation: Yesod/Malkhut channel imagery and central-path diagrams can serve as comparative neighbors for transmission/threshold, but Door remains a project-native operator.
